# Dino Studio

> Dino Studio works across event photography, highlight film, sports photojournalism, portraits, and digital visual design from Stockholm, Sweden. Founded by Dino Bavehjani (member of Svenska Journalistförbundet and Bildleverantörernas Förening).

- Primary location: Stockholm, Sweden (available across Sweden)
- Contact email: info@dinostudio.se
- Website: https://dinostudio.se/

## Main Pages

- [Startsida (SV)](https://dinostudio.se/sv/): Eventfoto, highlightfilm, porträtt och bildjournalistik i Stockholm.

- [Selected Work (EN)](https://dinostudio.se/en/work/): Portfolio across event & photography, sport & arena, film & moving image, and digital & web.
- [Tjänster (SV)](https://dinostudio.se/sv/services/): Event Content System, recurring photography & film, and digital/visual design.
- [Services (EN)](https://dinostudio.se/en/services/): Event Content System, recurring photography & film, and digital/visual design.
- [Om studion (SV)](https://dinostudio.se/sv/about/): Om Dino Studio, utbildning och pressackreditering.
